title: Ndvi2Gif: A Python Package for Multi-Seasonal Remote Sensing Analysis with Google Earth Engine
description: Ndvi2Gif is a Python library for multi-seasonal remote sensing analysis with Google Earth Engine: seasonal compositing and temporal analysis of satellite imagery (Sentinel-1/2/3, Landsat, MODIS), 40+ vegetation and environmental indices, SAR preprocessing, time series and per-pixel phenology, land cover classification, and automated GIF generation.
